nutrifruit.name: Nutrifruit
nutrifruit.shortDescription: Created by pastel Inc., the Nutrifruit is a highly modified tuber that is resistant to pests and diseases. It is cheap, has a high yield and is easy to grow, extremely nutritious, but purposefully seedless.

nutrifruit_seed.name: Nutrifruit Seed
nutrifruit_seed.shortDescription: A tuber, genetically modified to be hardy and fast growing. Requires nutrients and water to grow.

kotton_fiber.name: Kotton Fiber
kotton_fiber.shortDescription: A modified variant of traditional Cotton. Can be woven into highly durable and versatile fabric

kotton_seed.name: Kotton Seed
kotton_seed.shortDescription: A hard to grow seed that can be planted to grow more Kotton Fiber. It is a modified Cotton that can be woven into a durable fabric.

dream_cap.name: Dream Cap
dream_cap.shortDescription: Cause a slight euphoria and stomach pain when consumed. A key ingredient in Dream Dust

meal_cap.name: Meal Cap
meal_cap.shortDescription: A neutralized Dream Cap with no psychoactive properties. Legal and safe to eat. Cannot be processed into Dream Dust.

nightmare_cap.name: Nightmare Cap
nightmare_cap.shortDescription: Highly poisonous variant of the common Dream Cap. Can be processed into a deadly poison. Survivors report having horrible hallucinations after ingesting it.

plant_analyser.name: Plant Analyzer
plant_analyser.shortDescription: A specialized tool that can be used to analyse the growth of plants. It can be used to determine the optimal growing conditions for a plant.

fillerweed.name: Fillerweed
fillerweed.shortDescription: A fast-growing, yellowish leafy crop cultivated primarily in the Lower Levels. Offers almost no nutritional value, it is used as a filler in meals to stretch rations
fillerweed.flavorText: Has a mushy texture with a slightly bitter aftertaste.

fillerweed_seed.name: Fillerweed Seed
fillerweed_seed.shortDescription: A beginner-friendly, fast-growing seed that is not affected by nutrient or water quality.

hydroreed_seed.name: Hydroreed Seed
hydroreed_seed.shortDescription: A utility crops that produce no food. The Hydroreed will purify the water it is in while growing

bloomberry_seed.name: Bloomberry Seed
bloomberry_seed.shortDescription: A perennial bush. It doesn't die after fruiting. Keep its water clean for better bloomberries. Use a hatchet on the planter to clear it.

plant_dna_disk.name: DNA Data Disk
plant_dna_disk.shortDescription: A blank data disk. A DNA Manipulator can extract a trait onto it.
